sources.title: VeloC API
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: DCGM／Prometheus：GPU 區間平均與時間權重
related.titleEn: DCGM/Prometheus: GPU interval averages and time weighting
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：未完成版本保持pending，不改標成已備份。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Unfinished versions remain pending, not relabeled backed up.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「DCGM／Prometheus：GPU 區間平均與時間權重」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付時間區段表、加權平均、缺樣策略及指標定義。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct DCGM/Prometheus: GPU interval averages and time weighting with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver interval tables, weighted means, missing-data policy and metric definitions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以600秒視窗計checkpoint產量與背景容量，寫明流體近似。
將30秒與70秒畫成不同寬度，計面積再除總長。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute production and drain capacity over 600 seconds, explicitly using a fluid approximation.
Draw intervals with widths thirty and seventy and divide total area by total time.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: SCI 軟體碳強度：能源、隱含碳與功能單位
related.titleEn: Software Carbon Intensity: energy, embodied carbon and functional units
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：未完成版本保持pending，不改標成已備份。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Unfinished versions remain pending, not relabeled backed up.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「SCI 軟體碳強度：能源、隱含碳與功能單位」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付SCI邊界、E/I/M/R帳本、兩情境與排程限制。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Software Carbon Intensity: energy, embodied carbon and functional units with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver SCI boundaries, E/I/M/R ledgers, two scenarios and scheduling constraints.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以600秒視窗計checkpoint產量與背景容量，寫明流體近似。
計100×400營運排放，加10000隱含碳，再除100完成job。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute production and drain capacity over 600 seconds, explicitly using a fluid approximation.
Compute 100×400 operational emissions, add 10000 embodied emissions and divide by 100 completed jobs.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
